name: devflow
description: Simple multi-stage CI/CD demo for IBM Q2D Project 21

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const dir='dist'; fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}); for (const item of ['src','public','package.json','package-lock.json']) { const srcPath=path.join(process.cwd(), item); const destPath=path.join(process.cwd(), dir, item); if (fs.existsSync(srcPath)) { fs.cpSync(srcPath, destPath, {recursive:true}); } }"

author: IBM Q2D Participant
